findings.title: Allocated mission criteria reject the newly supported UNKNOWN MethodCheck and prevent durable outcome/check completion
findings.requirement: Architecture 9.10 requires checker-unavailable/undecidable UNKNOWN with retained gaps and addressable result/check; selected mission criteria/outcomes remain separate and cannot silently omit uncertainty. Plan 7.1 requires the affected actual caller, not a helper-only or unallocated positive.
findings.observed: outcome_payloads accepts COMPLETE and INCOMPLETE on the same existing two-criteria fixture and returns two BLOCKED outcomes with oracle/control gaps; UNKNOWN raises CRITERION_CHECK_REQUIRED. The transaction in _check writes the check and outcomes together, so this exception rolls the check/outcomes back while the separately committed raw result remains. Readback with such a check would also reject through _verify_graph. The candidate's UNKNOWN PG case deliberately uses with_criteria=False, avoiding this necessary consumer.
findings.source_reproducer: Use api/.venv/bin/python -I -B with api/src and api/tests inserted in sys.path; reuse test_c04_criteria.criteria_graph([uuid4, uuid4]) and the existing SOURCE rule setup in test_c10_bound_predicates.test_incomplete_check_rule_is_blocked_not_functional_pass. Keep otherwise-identical brief/result/check refs, result criterion pairs, checked_results and gap_refs; vary only method-check.status through COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE, UNKNOWN, then call criterion_checks.outcome_payloads(brief,result,check,graph).

executed_results.COMPLETE: two BLOCKED outcomes; gaps ORACLE_UNAVAILABLE, CONTROLS_UNAVAILABLE
executed_results.INCOMPLETE: two BLOCKED outcomes; same gaps plus METHOD_INCOMPLETE
executed_results.interpretation: Probe assertions confirmed the defect; exit zero is not product acceptance. Outcome-rule seam uses synthetic check records, not native authentication or PostgreSQL proof.

findings.remedy: Adapt the affected criterion caller to retain UNKNOWN as a non-success BLOCKED outcome with explicit uncertainty gaps/reason/check binding. Do not relabel it INCOMPLETE or omit allocated criteria. Add same-channel SOURCE controls and a real affected QA scenario with allocated criteria. This already disclosed omission is still an acceptance blocker; an author allowlist does not waive it.

findings.title: A newly persisted checker-unavailable UNKNOWN is regenerated as COMPLETE on receive-only readback
findings.requirement: Architecture 9.10 requires immutable exact result/check lineage and explicit UNKNOWN/gaps, with historical reception separate from new authority. A newly recorded UNKNOWN must remain readable/replayable without acquiring retrospective COMPLETE or deleting its recorded gaps.
findings.observed: For the recognized historical FULL checker digest 388fe9da680951249202045b10e10245d42352a0c194413d221d647b54a085db and original 4a3606b8e0354bceb8066f6de536932ee420d1147aa9311084ceafb4afbea850 composer, first check returns UNKNOWN/METHOD_CHECKER_UNAVAILABLE with three gaps. After retaining that check, _result_check sets receive_only=True; verify now admits the historical checker and regenerates COMPLETE with zero gaps. The retained_unknown special case recognizes only the schema-unavailable reason, not checker-unavailable UNKNOWN. The equality guards consequently raise RESULT_CONFLICT on actual persisted readback/reconcile rather than preserve the first verdict. The changed test explicitly compares UNKNOWN first-check to historical COMPLETE replay but never tests retaining the newly generated UNKNOWN.
findings.source_reproducer: Reuse test_contract_method_checks.native_case(predicates=True, composer_pin='4a3606b8e0354bceb8066f6de536932ee420d1147aa9311084ceafb4afbea850'); replace checker with records.envelope('method-checker', {'key': KEY, 'semantics': SEMANTICS, 'code_digest': '388fe9da680951249202045b10e10245d42352a0c194413d221d647b54a085db'}). Compare case.check() and case.check(receive_only=True). Also exercise actual ManagedAdmission._result_check twice over the same SOURCE native execution/manifest/final/binding graph, adding the first check to the graph before call two and using an in-memory schema reader returning case.schemas.

executed_results.interpretation: Actual _result_check seam exercised without DB; graph/run and schema reader are synthetic, SOURCE execution records use the existing helper. RESULT_CONFLICT at the enclosing immutable equality guard is code-traced, not a live PostgreSQL assertion. No native process/model/target was launched.

findings.remedy: Distinguish historical checks actually recorded by the old checker from newly recorded UNKNOWN under the current checker. Preserve the latter's exact payload/gaps on receive-only validation while still validating retained result/receipt/input integrity. Keep both historical COMPLETE and partial INCOMPLETE compatibility positives, and add the first-current-UNKNOWN -> persist -> readback/reconcile regression. Do not grant new COMPLETE merely because any prior check exists.

trace.assessment: Single trusted predicate/key/one slot/strict boolean/on_missing finite allowlist; producer reconstructs applies_if with the original Ref rather than mutating a mapping copy. All requirements and required flags retained; basis is the exact original RecordEnvelope Ref. Missing compile input yields UNKNOWN with no invented basis. General preconditions/invalidation/evidence remain rejected.

Backend structural assignment alone accepts a known conditional row with exact basis, but native preflight independently derives the row from actual material and refuses UNKNOWN/foreign/false plan. Native SOURCE result builder retains every row and binds NOT_APPLICABLE to original input, empty artifacts and explicit reason; conservatively returns INCONCLUSIVE. It does not skip the PURE procedure.

trace.seam: Authenticated native final -> raw persistence -> independent MethodCheck
trace.assessment: Wire validators support genuine four/six-record INCONCLUSIVE outputs. Existing owner authentication/manifest/binding seam precedes raw commit; raw records remain addressable before checker transaction. Checker validates exact child/header/input/context/action/receipt/artifact refs and limits without running PURE handlers. It recomputes applicability against original input, rejects false NA and retains INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN gaps. SOURCE tests prove the deterministic seam, not authentication/process/PG integration.

Required flags stay [true,true,false] in covered first-party cases. Optional rows are never omitted. All non-DONE rows, including NA, currently conservatively make INCOMPLETE/INCONCLUSIVE; this does not claim the full normative optional-completion policy. NA requires actual known input predicate proof; unavailable schema/checker generates UNKNOWN/all obligation gaps rather than NA. Missing conditional input is compile-UNKNOWN but assignment/native reject access. Tests condition the required second row; optional conditional behavior has no explicit product QA in this candidate.

Task success requires COMPLETE; INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN project BLOCKED. Schema-unavailable UNKNOWN has a retained-reason path, while checker-unavailable UNKNOWN does not. Allocated criteria still reject UNKNOWN. These are concrete missing callers, not permission to bypass acceptance. Historical old composer/partial-checker identities are enumerated receive-only; freshly produced old-pin fixtures are not installed historical-reader proof.
